name: gdquest-demos/godot-procedural-generation
description: A collection of procedural generation algorithms and playable demos for the Godot game engine covering WFC, maze generation, and terrain techniques. Published by GDQuest as an educational open-source reference.
score_rationale: Well-maintained educational repository from a leading Godot education platform covering multiple PCG algorithms with runnable demos.
summary: GDQuest's educational collection of PCG algorithms with runnable Godot demos.
